rows.text: Create Day-0 prerequisites covering infrastructure, identities, KMS/HSM keys, trust anchors, databases, secure time, network policy, certificates, and capacity.
Create Day-1 deployment steps with commands, configuration validation, schema migration, service startup order, readiness checks, canary verification, and rollback points.
Create Day-2 procedures for policy publication, trust-anchor rotation, key rotation, certificate renewal, node enrollment/revocation, quarantine review, backup, restore, and capacity scaling.
Include exact preconditions, required permissions, expected outputs, failure branches, and post-action verification for each procedure.
Provide troubleshooting decision trees keyed to stable error/reason codes and observability signals.
Include controlled procedures for dependency outage, time integrity failure, replay-store saturation, audit-ledger outage, and site disconnection.
Include upgrade/downgrade compatibility checks and prohibit rollback that weakens monotonic security state.
Include disaster-recovery and failback steps validated against scheduled game-day evidence.
rows.note: INFRA: game-day evidence

rows.text: Keep commands/scripts version-controlled and test them in staging; avoid undocumented manual console steps.
Assign runbook owners/review cadence and link alerts directly to the appropriate procedure.
